description: This file defines a React custom hook `useGameLogic` that encapsulates the game logic for a Tic Tac Toe game. It manages game state such as the board, current player, winner/draw status, game history, and provides functions for playing moves, resetting the game, and undoing moves. It also produces accessible messages about the game state for screen readers.

methods.name: useGameLogic()
methods.description: Main function that manages the Tic Tac Toe game state and provides an interface for interacting with the game.

methods.name: playAt
methods.description: Handles a player making a move at a specified index on the board, updating the game state accordingly.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the game state to start a new game.

methods.name: undo
methods.description: Reverts the game state to the previous move, if any.
